Subtract the equations:

\[
\left(A+\frac{B}{4}\right)-\left(A-\frac{B}{2}\right)=85-105
\]

\[
\frac{3B}{4}=-20 \implies B=-\frac{80}{3}.
\]

Then

\[
A=105+\frac{B}{2}=105-\frac{40}{3}=\frac{275}{3}.
\]

So

\[
a_n=\frac{275}{3}-\frac{80}{3}\left(-\frac12\right)^n.
\]

For \(n=2011\), which is odd,

\[
a_{2011}=\frac{275}{3}+\frac{80}{3\cdot 2^{2011}}.
\]

Since \(0<\frac{80}{3\cdot 2^{2011}}<\frac13\), the value is between \(91\) and \(92\). Thus the integer part is

\[
\boxed{91}.
\]
